items.title: Frank Amacker Interview, 1960-09-30
items.q: The interviewee discusses Bichet's playing history and associations (Piron, Mario Perez, Frank Kahino) but does not describe a direct personal or professional relationship between himself and Bichet.

ctx.x: Oh, he played all of them. At one time he was down there. Played at Piron sometime. Then Mario Perez sometime. I used to play, you see, had so many different bands downtown in that day. All different men had bands. And that day, all you had to do was play and get you a bunch of men together. Played at Jimmy Pileout sometime. He played everybody sometime.
